children: – The Food Security Laboratory 2026 will be held on November 1, focusing on accelerating investment projects, boosting local food production and addressing challenges facing the implementation of strategic programmes in the sector.

Organised by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the laboratory will review the sector’s strategic programmes, evaluate existing investment projects and identify practical solutions to overcome implementation challenges.

The laboratory will bring together government entities, government-owned companies, private sector institutions and civil society organisations to explore new investment opportunities, launch projects and introduce initiatives aimed at strengthening the growth and sustainability of the food security sector.

It aims to stimulate investment, promote the adoption of modern technologies, increase local production and enhance the added value of national products through the development of manufacturing industries.
These efforts are expected to contribute to the strengthening of the productive efficiency and sustainability of Oman’s food security system.

The programme will include specialised workshops with the participation of experts, investors and representatives of relevant stakeholders to discuss investment opportunities, identify challenges and develop practical solutions. The workshops will also seek to strengthen cooperation among participating entities and accelerate the implementation of investment projects during the next phase.

Dr Masood bin Sulaiman Al Azri, Director-General of Agricultural and Fisheries Marketing at the ministry and general supervisor of the laboratory, said the 2026 edition builds on a series of laboratories launched in 2021.
He said the previous laboratories had resulted in the development of 494 investment projects, with total investments estimated at RO1.87bn.
Al Azri highlighted the importance of the laboratories in strengthening public-private partnerships, identifying promising investment opportunities and overcoming challenges facing investors.

He stressed the need to accelerate project implementation and enhance the efficiency of productive sectors, supporting their contribution to the national economy and strengthening food security in Oman.

title: ZAWYA: Oman: Food Security Laboratory targets accelerated local investment
